pages.text: $(bold)Create$() and its family: $(bold)Steam 'n' Rails$() (trains), $(bold)Big Cannons$(), $(bold)Diesel Generators$(), $(bold)Enchantment Industry$(), $(bold)Dragons Plus$(), $(bold)Trading Floor$() (depots), $(bold)Create Deco$() and $(bold)Interiors$() (looks), $(bold)Create Better Villagers$() (trades), $(bold)Slice & Dice$() (kitchen).$(br2)$(bold)Valkyrien Skies$() + $(bold)Eureka$() are ships; $(bold)Valkyrien Pirates$() sail them against you.

$(bold)Trotting Wagons$() and $(bold)Caravans & Convoys$() move goods by horse. $(bold)Storage Drawers$() (+Create compat) are visible bulk storage. $(bold)Workshop$() tables craft from the chests around them. $(bold)Backpacked$() is the backpack; $(bold)Supplementaries$() the sacks, ropes, pulleys and a hundred small things.
$(bold)Macaw's$() nine mods are doors, roofs, windows, fences, bridges, paths, stairs, trapdoors, lights, paintings and furniture; $(bold)Every Compat$() makes every wood work with all of it.
